body:
The 16:9 vehicle frame incorrectly included the demo stepper, navigation buttons, and explanatory copy. They consumed display height and made the actual vehicle UI smaller than the intended 2560×1440 canvas.

Move the demo controller beneath the physical display. Only the vehicle status bar, application panels, and dock occupy the 16:9 frame; the panels use all remaining height. Keep urgent product notices inside the display. Preserve editor focus and drafts across transitions, reveal an editor reached from the external controller, and prevent hidden material geometry from overflowing after a narrow resize.

Validation: TypeScript and production build; Playwright display-boundary checks at 1440, 1920, and 2560 px; 2560×1440 screenshot with demo controls starting below y=1440. Full regression: 394/395 passed. The existing maximum-duration voice-recording test timed out waiting for the save button; its isolated rerun passed (1/1) on the same source. The full-run failure cause is not established.

Not verified: physical vehicle display and native SDK integration. Existing responsive/document fallbacks remain for narrow screens and enlarged text.

Created with Codex.
title: fix(web): keep demo controls outside the vehicle display
